parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to return. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.

><notice>Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance level. The **ResourceGroupId** request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
></notice>
